whatToWatch.text: 6-4 and riding a two-game heat check into Levi's — Seattle's 3-point underdog label says close game, and the Seahawks' defense (17.5 points allowed per game) says they've been the better unit all year.
Pressure is the edge: Seattle's getting home 2.7 sacks a game to San Francisco's 1.7, and with Brock Purdy on the 49ers' out list, the pass rush gets a shot at an offense already down a starter.

Injury report cuts both ways — Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Ernest Jones IV headline three questionable and two out for Seattle, so depth guys may decide this one. With a 43.5 total, every possession in a low-scoring road grinder is going to matter.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle emerges from the bye with its defense riding a hot stretch and a win over the Raiders still fresh on the tape — now it heads to San Francisco to prove the layoff sharpened rather than stalled it. The quarterback conversation hasn't quieted, and neither have the health questions coaches spent the week sorting through. Answers come fast on the road against the Niners.
